bounded_reasons: identity has admin on the repository
classic `repo` grants full repository access; scope names cannot prove a bounded credential
identity can update the Project although this tool only reads it
denial of forbidden operations not tested
resource scope (single repository, single Project) not verified
enforcement: basic_access is an observation that the identity can act. bounded requires denial testing and resource-scope verification that this probe does not perform; scope headers and the admin flag alone never qualify a credential. The policy restricts what the tool writes; the credential boundary is enforced only by the token the operator provisions.

fine_grained: Projects: read (user-owned Projects are a documented fine-grained PAT limitation)
minimum.implementer_branch_privileges: separate identity: push to implementation branches and open PRs; not part of this tool's minimum
minimum.minimum_note: classic `repo` is broader than needed; `read:project` is enough for this tool's Project reads
